'''Brollyx''' was an [[Assistant-Viceprex]] employed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]] and stationed on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. When she chose to sue the [[Imperial Entertainers' Guild]] for the destruction of the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] penal facility, her decision was met with a considerable degree of protest from the Guild. [[Hokkor Long]], the Guild's [[Secretary in Charge of Scheduling]], dispatched a number of [[textfile]]s to Brollyx, in which he protested the treatment that the Guild's members were forced to endure at social functions sponsored by the Authority, and reiterated that the Guild was not responsible for the prison's destruction, nor could it be held responsible the actions of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Atuarre]], [[Pakka]] and [[BLX-5|Bollux]] when they had posed as members of the Guild in order to infiltrate Stars' End.<ref name="HSCS" />
